rationale: The diff shows app/page.tsx changed the input's aria-label from "New task" to "Task title", but the test still locates it via getByLabel("New task"). The failure is a locator.fill timeout on that stale selector, and it timed out on both the initial attempt and the retry, so it is deterministic selector drift rather than flake or a product regression. The app's blank-task behavior itself is not shown to be broken.
recommendedAction: Update the test to use getByLabel("Task title") (or a stable test id) to match the renamed input, then re-run the spec.
